name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. Growing up in the Highlands, he initially pursued a degree in psychology, fascinated by team dynamics and individual motivation. However, a chance internship with a local rally team sparked a passion for the high-octane world of racing. He quickly realized his skills in understanding human behavior could be invaluable in managing the complex personalities within a motorsport team.

Alistair believes in fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. He strives to create a culture where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. He's particularly adept at conflict resolution and ensuring that the team functions cohesively, even under immense pressure. Alistair's pragmatic approach and commitment to fairness make him a valuable asset to Allied Racing, ensuring a happy and productive workforce.

He's not afraid to challenge the status quo, advocating for innovative HR practices that attract and retain top talent. He is also passionate about promoting diversity and inclusion within the team, believing that a diverse workforce leads to better outcomes and a more innovative environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side parting.
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a wiry build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Has a peculiar fondness for herbal tea, brewing a fresh pot several times a day.
Insists on starting every Monday morning with a team-building exercise, no matter how small.
